Exploitability_explanation: Thorough search of the codebase (including UI and backend) revealed no explicit calls to vulnerable node-tar APIs (tar.x, tar.extract, tar.Parse, tar.Unpack). The library is likely a transitive dependency of build tools or not used in active code paths. Per the Evidence Mandate, exploitability is set to 1% (not confirmed).

Thorough search revealed no calls to hono's parseBody API, specifically with the {dot: true} constraint required for this Prototype Pollution vulnerability. Hono is only present as a peer dependency of @hono/node-server and is not imported in the user code. Per the Evidence Mandate, exploitability is set to 1% (not confirmed).
